    Class TpButton

    an action button or navigation link with shared sizes, variants and loading states.

    Example

    <tp-button href="/#/components/button/index.md#usage">Read the usage guide</tp-button>

    Tagname

    tp-button

    Accessibility

    Uses a native button or a element according to the configured action.

    Accessibility

    Exposes disabled and loading states to assistive technology.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Provide visible text that describes the action or destination.

    Keyboard

    Uses the browser's native button activation behavior.
